title: MallWorld locations
content: Wish I knew the words to completely capture where I go every night in my dreams. MallWorld encompasses so many places in one dreamscape. I've been exploring AI imagery to try and create what I see when I'm there. Images 1-2 The lobby elevators of the grand beach/boardwalk resort/casino area. I am always afraid to ride on these. As most of you have experienced, they are incredibly fast and unpredictable. I'll try to warm other riders and they look at me like I'm crazy. Images 3-4 Within the resort/casino there is this dark bar. It has ornate wood furnishings, and a generally masculine smoky feel to it. I occasionally play pool or bowl here. The two bowling lanes are to the right of the bar, you have to climb like three steps to the area. The pictures can't capture the orientation in my head. There are also no windows in this area but dim old timey sconces on the back walls and pillars. There's also seated tables there. Images 5-6 The amusement park and Vegas like strip of hotels is also another area I frequent. There's a dangerous highway between the opposite sides. These images really don't capture the ominous feeling I usually have there. The rides are incredibly scary and at times it can feel like an emoty creepy county fair as you're walking through it. Images 7-11 Outside of MallWorld seems to be what I would envision my Heaven. Almost like Neverland and What Dreams May Come combined. Half the landscape resembles the Napali Coast of Hawaii with waterfalls, lagoons and a beach. The other half of the landscape is a beautiful mountainous rolling hills covered in wildflowers. I have a house on the hill cliff beside a tree of life. The image puts my house on the tree and cliff, in actuality the tree is located in the backyard. At the face and base of the mountain resemble Italian towns like Cinque Terre and Lake Cuomo. The cutest promenade beside the water 🥰 There always seems to be a lovely festival occurring with everyone dressed in white. Let me know if these resonate. I've been trying to also generate images of other locations within.
